name: Pereira
registryBasis: Pereira’s official publications identify AMCO as the gestor catastral for the municipality. The official SIGPER web map references an AMCO terrain-cadastre layer; a public FeatureServer serves polygon geometry. Bounded response is labeled Terreno and is treated only as a physical ground/terrain cadastral unit, not a legal property-right, title or ownership register.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: All 917 bounded native cadastral references pass retrieval and geometry validity, but three complete containment overlaps total 455.93 m2 in metric audit. Fresh native EPSG9377 geometry reproduces the conflicts; all four involved rows have null end-of-version values. No documented ground-only exclusion resolves the overlapping terrain units.
scopeLimits: Official local publications identify AMCO as cadastral manager; public ArcGIS metadata returned HTTP 200, Polygon, EPSG:9377, safe OBJECTID. Bounded query around the unchanged WUP locator returned HTTP 200 and three polygons, with only OBJECTID requested. Dataset title is Terreno Catastro AMCO; interpretation is physical/ground cadastral geometry only.
remainingUncertainty: Citywide completeness, current geometry version, and the relationship between the physical terrain units and legal registered units remain unresolved.
